Samir (Sales): Heads-up — huge prospect (regulated infra) asks: single outbound port only, no persistent internet after install, very strict 90-day upgrade window max, and they want signed delta hotpatches + SBOMs. POC needs to prove we can deliver a tiny image and offline delta patches. Can EngOps/Prod confirm feasibility?
Alex W (Product): Short answer: doable but depends on packaging approach and signing workflow. Need clarity on what 'single outbound port' actually allows (TLS to a specific host? CDN?). :thinking_face:
Samir (Sales): They allow TCP/443 to a vendor-managed update host only (whitelisted IPs), no DNS to external names. They also insist on HSM-backed signing for binaries and delta manifests.
Mira L (SRE): OK. From infra side we can support a single egress to our artifact host. We'll need: 1) artifact host IP allowlist, 2) offline attestation package format, 3) signed manifest format (detached signatures), 4) delta patch tool that can apply patches without internet.
Pat - EngOps: Delta-patching is the tricky part. Our current offline bundle model supports chunked layers but we don't have a user-facing delta apply tool for on-prem customers yet. We can build one, ETA for POC: ~3 weeks with prioritized dev effort.
Samir (Sales): 3 weeks might be borderline — customer wants POC inside 2 weeks. Any fastpath?
Alex W (Product): Fastpath options: A) ship full compressed immutable bundle (bigger) + manual install script for POC; B) use existing bundle + rsync-style patching if network restrictions allow port 873 (unlikely); C) sign and ship per-container binary diffs using xdelta tool — we have engineers who've used xdelta in past. For strict HSM signing we'll need Legal + Security sign-off.
Jordan (Legal): We can support HSM-backed signing requirements but need to clarify liabilities: 1) Are we signing the delta manifests only or the actual binary blobs? 2) Do they require signature verification within the runtime? If yes, runtime changes needed. Also need to confirm export controls for crypto.
Mira L (SRE): Runtime signature verification can be added with small shim: verify manifest sig via PKCS#7 or COSE signed manifest before applying. Minimal runtime overhead. For POC we can mock verify with a software key to prove flow, then work with customer KMS/HSM for prod.
ops-bot: build-artifact 3112233445-2026-03-02T15:04:23Z sha256:ab12c3... deployed to artifactory-staging (size: 1.2GB)
Pat - EngOps: Note: current full bundle ~1.2GB. If they need <500MB footprint we must strip optional models or use quantized model build -> reduces to ~420MB but affects perf/latency. Need model owner sign-off.
Samir (Sales): They require <=500MB for the node image. Would quantized model be acceptable? Customer said slight quality degradation OK if latency is similar.
Alex W (Product): Quantization path looks promising. We can produce a quantized model bundle for the POC and sign it. Two caveats: 1) downgrades/rollback via deltas need symmetric diffs; 2) license: some model weights have redistribution constraints — must verify.
Jordan (Legal): I'll review model license terms. If model disallows redistribution, we need to discuss a different packaging or a sealed-exec model where weights stay encrypted and are never redistributed.
Mira L (SRE): For upgrade cadence: 90 days max between upgrades is fine. We need an upgrade policy doc: how we handle failed delta (atomic apply + automatic rollback), checksum verification, and manual fallback. I'll draft a minimal runbook.
Samir (Sales): Also customer wants SBOM for each bundle and proof of reproducible build. Can we produce SBOM + signed provenance for POC?
Pat - EngOps: We can produce CycloneDX SBOMs from the build pipeline. For reproducible build provenance, we can include git commit, build env hash, and artifact signature. That should satisfy POC level.
Alex W (Product): Proposed POC plan to fit 2-week window: 1) Week 1: prepare quantized minimal bundle (~420MB), create SBOM, sign manifests with software key, produce signed delta (xdelta) from base -> quantized; 2) Week 2: run on-customer isolated env with single egress to our artifactory IP, validate signature verification, apply delta, run smoke tests; 3) Parallel: Legal + Security review for HSM bring-your-own-key for production.
Jordan (Legal): I'll prioritize model license and signing liability review. If we can't transfer model weights under their contract, we can propose on-site encrypted bundle (customer holds KEK).
Mira L (SRE): For POC infra steps (high level): - Customer opens egress to 1 IP - We provide a tarball + detached sig (COSE) - Installer verifies sig then runs patcher - Patcher writes to a temp mount, verifies checksums, then atomically swaps. I'll attach a short runbook after standup.
Samir (Sales): Perfect. Can someone confirm exact artifact size we can hit if we remove optional telemetry + use 8-bit quantization? Need concrete number for customer.
Pat - EngOps: I'll run a quick build tonight with telemetry disabled and 8-bit quant; estimate ~380-430MB. Will post exact sha and size by EOD.
ops-bot: build-artifact 3112233499-2026-03-02T22:17:10Z sha256:cd34ef... size: 395MB (quantized, telemetry off)
Alex W (Product): Nice. That should meet <500MB. For POC, let's accept software signing so we don't block timeline. For production we'll swap to HSM-backed detached signatures and KMS integration.
Samir (Sales): Great — I'll communicate the plan and 2-week POC timeline to the customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Mira L (SRE): I'll drop the runbook and the minimal verification script in the handoff doc shortly.
Jordan (Legal): I'll confirm model license by EOD and follow up if any constraints.
Pat - EngOps: POC installer script snippet for offline apply: ```bash
# apply delta
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 || exit 1
xdelta3 -d -s base.img delta.xd new.img
# atomic swap
mount /dev/loop0 new.img /mnt/new || exit 1
mv /usr/bin/app /usr/bin/app.old && cp /mnt/new/usr/bin/app /usr/bin/app
```
Samir (Sales): Thanks — keeping this thread as our single source of truth. Let's sync tomorrow if anything blocks.
